bugs.title: Order total shows 0 kr after applying a discount code
bugs.description: After entering the code SAVE10 in the cart, the total drops to 0 kr instead of 10 % less. It only happens when the cart holds more than one product.
steps: Add two different products to the cart
Open the cart and enter the code SAVE10
bugs.actual: The total is 0 kr with two products; with one product it is correct

agentReview.method: reproduced three times, with one and with two products

bugs.title: Card number field has no accessible name
bugs.description: The card number input has neither a visible label nor an aria-label.
bugs.expected: The field is announced as "Card number"
bugs.actual: axe-core reports the rule label as serious

agentReview.method: axe-core scan, then read the markup

bugs.title: The discount code field is emptied after a wrong code
bugs.description: Entering an unknown code empties the field, so the customer has to type the whole code again.
steps: Enter the code WRONG and press Apply
bugs.expected: The field keeps the text and shows an error
bugs.actual: The field is empty and the error disappears after two seconds
